g_title: You’ve been given a Date Deck
g_lead: Inside are 114 ideas for your dates. Open the deck in the app with the code below, and take turns drawing.
g_once: The code works once: it burns out after opening.
g_none: No code in this link. Type it in the app on the home screen: it’s printed on the card.
nf_p: The link is wrong or out of date.
g_steps: Install Date Deck on your iPhone.
Tap “Open in the app” or type the code on the home screen.
Sign in with email or Apple, and you’re all set.
